trust.note: Trust and reputation (TODO M8). The village distrusts the farm at first (it burned, the family was blamed, everybody is poor); it warms as the farm visibly recovers (reputation: the number of main goals done, one level per `perLevel`) and each trader warms to the farmer who does them a good turn (their `deeds`: deliveries handed over to them; one level per deed, at most `max`). Both lower the prices of seeds and wares (never raise them): reputation by discount[level], each trust level by `perLevel` of the price; the sum never goes below `floor`. Nobody is ever angry: with no trust the price is simply the list price.
